title: BCC Ruling No. 13-12-1340 — ground snow-load value for a Hamilton addition
code_edition: Ontario Building Code 2006, O. Reg. 350/06 (as cited)

facts.text: The case concerns a proposed one-storey rear addition and change from Group C to Group B, Division 3 occupancy at 35–37 Ogilvie Street, Dundas.
The submitted roof-truss calculation used an SB-1 ground snow load of 0.9 kPa; a City of Hamilton departmental policy listed 1.1 kPa for the location.
The dispute cites Division B Sentences 1.1.2.1.(1) and 4.1.6.2.(1), and discusses climatic values in Supplementary Standard SB-1.
